page_title: SAL 1-1 FRO | Salernitana v Frosinone 22/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+2' The substitution is prepared. Mehdi Bourabia (Frosinone) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Enzo Barrenechea.
90+1' Domagoj Bradaric (Salernitana) attempts to find Chukwubuikem Ikwuemesi, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
88' Jaime Baez Stabile (Frosinone) sends a cross into the box, but Guillermo Ochoa comes off his line to gather the ball.
85' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Mateusz Legowski (Salernitana) is coming onto the pitch as Agustin Martegani cannot continue after picking up an injury.
84' A substitution has been made. Matteo Lovato goes off and Flavius Daniliuc (Salernitana) comes on.
84' Paulo Sousa has decided to make a change. Erik Botheim (Salernitana) replaces Jovane Cabral.
84' Salernitana quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
82' Luca Garritano (Frosinone) lashes the free kick from the edge of the box but it flies high over the bar, somewhere into the stands.
81' Matteo Lovato (Salernitana) is very lucky to stay on the pitch after using excessive force to bring down his opponent with a two-footed challenge.
80' Luca Mazzitelli (Frosinone) tries to bend in the free kick from the edge of the box, but the defensive wall makes an easy block.

79' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Grigoris Kastanos (Salernitana). Marco Piccinini saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul. Frosinone have a free kick from a promising distance.
78' Substitution. Giulio Maggiore did his best and is replaced by Emil Bohinen (Salernitana).
77' Eusebio Di Francesco has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Marvin Cuni (Frosinone) replacing Walid Cheddira.
77' The substitution has been made. Giorgi Kvernadze (Frosinone) has replaced Matias Soule.
75' Good defending. Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) tries to find Jovane Cabral inside the box, but the pass is cut out.
73' The ref blows his whistle and we are going to have a so-called cooling break due to the high temperature.
72' Lorenzo Pirola (Salernitana) is forced to stop his forward run after being caught in an offside position by the linesman.
72' Salernitana work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

71' Chukwubuikem Ikwuemesi (Salernitana) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the bottom left corner. Stefano Turati guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save.
71' Total attempts – 17:7. 5:3 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.

68' Jaime Baez Stabile (Frosinone) threw away a promising scoring opportunity. He received a fine cross inside the 6-yard box, but his shot missed the target close to the right post. Jaime Baez Stabile (Frosinone) was standing in a clear offside position, making it an easy call for the linesman.
67' Substitution. Chukwubuikem Ikwuemesi (Salernitana) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Pasquale Mazzocchi walks off.
66' Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) sends a long ball forward to Pasquale Mazzocchi, but he put too much power and the chance is gone. The ball goes out of play and Frosinone will have a goal kick.
65' Matias Soule (Frosinone) takes the corner but it's cleared.

65' Riccardo Marchizza (Frosinone) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance. The ball goes out of play. Frosinone are awarded a corner kick.
62' Eusebio Di Francesco prepares a substitution. Giuseppe Caso is replaced by Jaime Baez Stabile (Frosinone).
62' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Luca Garritano (Frosinone) will replace Marco Brescianini.
61' The goalkeeper punched the ball away after Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) took the corner.

61' Jovane Cabral (Salernitana) misses a big chance from point-blank range as he struck the ball towards the bottom right corner. His promising effort following the corner kick was, to his disappointment, thwarted by Stefano Turati with a fabulous save.
61' Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.

60' Giulio Maggiore (Salernitana) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the top left corner. However, Stefano Turati anticipates the shot and makes a brilliant save. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Salernitana.
59' Marco Brescianini (Frosinone) makes his forward run a little too early and is caught in an offside position after his teammate tries to play a pass to him.
57' Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) strikes a shot towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it flies just wide of the left post.
55' Domagoj Bradaric whips the ball in and it arrives at the feet of Pasquale Mazzocchi (Salernitana), whose wild shot goes way over the crossbar.

52' 1 - 1 It's a goal! Antonio Candreva delivers a teasing cross from the resulting corner and the ball falls into the space where Jovane Cabral (Salernitana) is lurking. His precise shot from close range goes straight inside the right post and it's 1:1.
52' A quickly taken corner by Salernitana.

52' Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the right side of the goal. However, Stefano Turati anticipates the shot and makes a brilliant save. Salernitana force a corner. They send men into the box.
51' Matias Soule (Frosinone) produces an effort from the edge of the box, but doesn't hit the ball properly and sends it yards over the bar.
51' Frosinone take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

50' Riccardo Marchizza (Frosinone) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Frosinone.

49' Luca Mazzitelli (Frosinone) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls the ball and releases it under the roof. Unfortunately for him, Guillermo Ochoa makes a great save to stop his effort.
48' Pasquale Mazzocchi (Salernitana) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Marco Piccinini had an easy-decision to make.
48' Lorenzo Pirola (Salernitana) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his header wasn't accurate at all and the ball went well over the bar.
47' Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) works the corner short.

47' Agustin Martegani (Salernitana) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Salernitana.
46' Grigoris Kastanos (Salernitana) takes the corner with a short pass.
46' The ball is cleared after Jovane Cabral (Salernitana) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The linesman points to the corner flag, Salernitana are going to take it.
46' Referee Marco Piccinini blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+6' The end of the first half.
45+4' Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender.
45+2' PENALTY APPEAL after Walid Cheddira (Frosinone) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
45+1' Frosinone take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
45' 5 additional min. will be played.

45' A lofted cross from Giuseppe Caso (Frosinone) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Frosinone will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
45' Matias Soule (Frosinone) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
44' Walid Cheddira (Frosinone) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Frosinone get a corner.
43' Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) is clearly in an offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
39' Salernitana take a short corner kick.
36' Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots to the bottom left corner, but Stefano Turati pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
34' Grigoris Kastanos (Salernitana) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
34' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Caleb Okoli (Frosinone) was quite harsh and Marco Piccinini didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
32' The game is interrupted now, Caleb Okoli (Frosinone) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
30' Giuseppe Caso (Frosinone) is awarded a yellow card for a sharp discussion with the referee. He should relax or he could be sent off.

29' Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away. Giulio Maggiore (Salernitana) decides to take on the shot from mid-range after a rebound, but he fails to connect properly with the ball and the effort sails harmlessly wide of the left post.
27' The referee blows his whistle and players are going to refresh themselves.
25' Matias Soule (Frosinone) tricks his way to the edge of the box where he shoots at goal. The keeper scrambles to cover the effort, but it goes just wide of the left post.

25' Walid Cheddira (Frosinone) wastes a great chance from the resulting corner. He times his header superbly when he leaps high to meet a precise cross, but can't aim better than into the middle of the goal, straight into the arms of the goalkeeper.
25' It will be a corner kick for Frosinone.
24' Stefano Turati steps in and intercepts a long pass from Jovane Cabral (Salernitana).
21' Grigoris Kastanos (Salernitana) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and shoots. His poorly placed shot flies well wide of the left post.
19' Jovane (Salernitana) is caught offside yet again.
17' GOAL DISALLOWED! Controversy and anger as Giuseppe Caso (Frosinone) has a goal ruled out, incredibly, for offside.
16' Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Stefano Turati, who smothers the ball.

12' 0 - 1 It's in! Simone Romagnoli (Frosinone) finds space in the box and from close range powers an unstoppable header into the right of the goal after a cheeky lofted pass from Riccardo Marchizza. 0:1.
11' Giuseppe Caso (Frosinone) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
11' Giuseppe Caso (Frosinone) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The referee signals a corner kick to Frosinone.
10' Jovane Cabral (Salernitana) muscles his way past two defenders but his shot from inside the box smashes against the crossbar!
9' Pasquale Mazzocchi (Salernitana) tries to find Jovane Cabral, but he puts too much power on the through ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Frosinone.
8' Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) takes a short free kick.
5' Grigoris Kastanos (Salernitana) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
2' Jovane (Salernitana) fails to time his run beyond the last defender and the linesman makes a good call by signalling for offside after seeing the whole situation unfold.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out at last! Salernitana will take the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Marco Piccinini.
